# Groucho

**Recordings:** 39

## Background

Groucho Marx hosted *You Bet Your Life*, a comedy quiz program that began on radio in 1947. Its appeal depended as much on Groucho's improvised conversations with contestants as on the quiz itself. The series subsequently moved to television. [Further episode research](https://www.worldradiohistory.com/).
